stops.note: named the large, rabbit-sized forest rodent
French colonists in the Caribbean and Guiana recorded the rodent under its Tupi-Guarani name
borrowed into English natural history accounts
stops.meaning: a rabbit-sized rodent native to Central and South America

current_meaning: a rabbit-sized, long-legged rodent native to Central and South America, also lending its name to a common animal coat coloring pattern
